basic_profile.bio: A 39-year-old lyricist and freelance writer from Austin, Texas. Passionate about rap battles and multisyllabic rhyming schemes, I've been honing my craft since my teenage years. When I'm not on Reddit, I'm either working on my music blog, exploring new rap albums, or volunteering at the local community center. I dislike negativity and unnecessary online drama. I am usually online during late evenings after 8 PM CST, as that's when I find my creative juices flowing. I'm currently single and happily focusing on my career and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of lyrical composition and rap culture, acquired through years of personal study and participation in online rap battles. My knowledge is further supplemented by attending various rap workshops and collaborating with other artists. Additionally, I have a degree in English Literature, which helps in articulating complex ideas and wordplay.
